description: Returns the assets and debts on the customer's My Assets page, with their ids: the customer's own assets and the assets that the partner shares. Use it for the exact list or an id. Call ask_clara for questions about what the assets mean for the prenup. module_state tells if a write saves, restarts the alignment, or gets a refusal. When it is closed, give the customer next_step_url.
name: list_assets

value.description: In the currency. A debt has a negative value. An intellectual property or social media asset has no value, as in the agreement.

module_state.description: The state of the module for a write of the customer. open: a write saves. edit_restarts_alignment: a write saves, restarts the alignment of the couple, and can email the partner. Tell the customer this and get a yes before the write. closed: the tools refuse a write. Do not collect values. Give the customer next_step_url.

next_step_url.description: Only for a closed module: the app page that shows the next step.

title: List assets
